overall: Committee did not violate the OML: the July 26 notice was posted over 48 hours ahead on the district website, and the late-materials claim was declined as not a violation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged meeting notices, including for the July 26 meeting, were sent out only on the day of the meeting rather than 48 hours in advance.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Committee properly posted notice of its July 26 meeting, in compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged it was unclear where the Committee's meetings are posted for public viewing.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee asserts, and we find, that all notices of Committee meetings were posted online and accessible from the website http://www.nrsd.org.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to send meeting materials to interested recipients until the day of the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent the complaint alleges as a separate violation that the Committee failed to send meeting materials to interested recipients until the day of the meeting, this allegation, even if true, would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law and we decline to review it.
